title: Package Reliability Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Package Reliability Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own the reliability of our packaged products, from defining mission profiles and reliability targets to identifying package-level failure mechanisms, developing qualification strategies, and making evidence-based release recommendations.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Architecture, Device Reliability, Product Engineering, and OSAT/laboratory partners to translate product use cases into mission profiles and FIT/MTBF targets. You will assess reliability risks, define and execute package-level reliability test plans, lead failure analysis activities, and ensure findings are driven to resolution.

Your core focus will be to transform product requirements into robust reliability strategies, validate package concepts through targeted stress testing, and provide data-driven recommendations that enable confident product release.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

- Own mission profiles and reliability targets by defining product operating conditions (temperature, voltage, humidity, thermal cycling, and lifetime requirements) and allocating FIT, MTBF, and lifetime targets across package, interconnect, and device-level contributors.

- Assess package reliability risks by evaluating failure mechanisms across substrates, die attach, interconnects, solder joints, board attach, and optical/fiber interfaces, including delamination, warpage, fatigue, electromigration, and optical or electrical drift.

- Define and execute package reliability qualification plans covering thermal, mechanical, environmental, and board-level stress testing in accordance with JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, IEC, and customer-specific requirements.

- Lead the technical interface with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and labs, defining reliability requirements, reviewing data, and challenging results when the supporting evidence is insufficient or unrepresentative.

- Drive root-cause investigations and failure analysis, leveraging techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, SEM/EDX, and related methods, and translate findings into CAPA/8D actions, design improvements, and requalification decisions.

- Develop risk-based qualification strategies for novel packaging technologies, such as UBC and optical interconnects, where industry standards are incomplete or do not yet exist.

- Provide data-driven release recommendations by assessing whether products are ready for customer sampling, qualification milestones, or production release, while clearly communicating any remaining reliability risks.

Your Qualifications

- Educational background with a Master's degree (or equivalent experience) i

We are looking for a Principal Security Engineer to serve as one of HelloFresh's most senior technical authorities in Security - shaping how we protect the company today while defining the security foundations we will need for the future.

This is not a Principal role defined by ownership of a single security domain. Your domain is HelloFresh.

You will operate at the intersection of technology strategy, security architecture, engineering and business risk , influencing some of the most consequential technical decisions we make. You will partner with senior Engineering, Product, Data, IT and business leadership to ensure security is not something applied after strategic decisions are made, but a fundamental input into those decisions. 

You think in systems, not Initiatives - and in years, not quarters.

Where others see an IAM issue, application vulnerability, endpoint incident or AI risk, you look for the architectural condition connecting them. You ask not only “How do we fix this?” but “Why can this class of failure exist at HelloFresh, and what should we change so that it becomes difficult by design?”

Your job is not merely to secure the systems HelloFresh has today. It is to influence what HelloFresh builds next, define the security architecture that makes it possible, and raise the technical capability of the organisation so that secure-by-default becomes a property of the company itself.

You will bring exceptional breadth across Cloud Security, Application & Product Security, Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, Detection & Response, Enterprise IT Security, IAM & Zero Trust, Endpoint/MDM, Governance & Risk, Third-Party & Supply-Chain Security, and GenAI Security - with the depth and judgment to challenge our strongest specialists and go hands-on when the hardest problems demand it.

• Make Security AI-native. Identify operational work across Security that should no longer require repetitive human execution. Drive agents, automation, internal security products and self-service capabilities that encode security expertise and make it available at company scale - with appropriate permissions, human oversight, evaluation and auditability.

• Shape company and Group strategy through Security. Act as a strategic technical advisor to senior and executive leadership, influencing multi-year technology and business strategy across platforms, products, cloud, enterprise technology, AI, acquisitions and emerging technologies. Translate complex security issues into choices involving customer trust, resilience, engineering velocity, investment and business risk.

• Own and elevate secure design and architecture at scale across HelloFresh. Define our security architectural principles, reference architectures, trust boundaries, standards, patterns and guardrails with the security leads. Act as a senior technical advisor for our most consequential architecture and security-risk decisions.

• Connect the entire security system. Identify systemic risks that individual teams cannot see or solve in isolation. Bring the industry perspective to implementation.

• Eliminate classes of risk, not individual findings. Drive secure-by-default cloud and product architecture across AWS, Kubernetes, IAM, networking, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD and software supply chains. description:

description:
Are you a Mapudungun language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful tools for communication, education, and cultural preservation. title: Client Services Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Client Services Specialist who can take genuine ownership of our client relationships.
Your job is to make sure clients feel supported, informed, and confident in the work we’re doing together. You’ll keep commitments moving, spot risks before they become problems, and ensure that important details don’t disappear into an inbox, meeting, or Slack thread.

This is not a reactive customer-support role. It’s also not a role where “following up” simply means asking everybody else for an update.

We need someone who can understand what a client is trying to achieve, coordinate the work required to get them there, and confidently own the communication along the way.

What you’ll be responsible for

• Build strong, trusted relationships with our clients.

• Understand each client’s goals, priorities, expectations, and current sentiment.

• Serve as the bridge between clients and the internal team.

• Lead client meetings and turn conversations into clear decisions, owners, and deadlines.

• Make sure every commitment is properly recorded and followed through.

• Keep ClickUp and client records accurate enough that another team member can confidently step in when needed.

• Proactively communicate progress, delays, risks, and changes-before clients need to ask.

• Identify unhappy, disengaged, or at-risk clients early and coordinate an appropriate response.

• Manage onboarding, ongoing client rhythms, milestones, renewals, and cancellations with care.

• Coordinate smooth handovers and coverage when somebody is out of office.

• Escalate issues with context, possible solutions, and a clear recommendation.

• Help improve the systems and processes we use to deliver a consistently excellent client experience.

What success looks like:

• Clients know what is happening and what comes next.

• Internal team members understand exactly what they own.

• Commitments have named owners and realistic due dates.

• Risks are surfaced early rather than discovered during a crisis.

• Client information is current, clear, and easy to find.

• Meetings end with decisions and action, not additional confusion.

• Leave and handovers do not disrupt the client experience.

• Leadership does not need to chase you for updates or remind you about follow-ups.

• Clients see you as a trusted partner rather than simply a point of contact.

You’ll probably be great at this if you:

• Are naturally warm, thoughtful, and confident with people.

• Communicate clearly without sounding robotic or overly corporate.

• Have excellent follow-through and notice when something is about to fall through a gap.

• Can bring structure to situations that are still slightly messy.

• Take ownership without waiting to be told about every next step.

• Are comfortable having honest conversations when expectations, scope, or timelines need to be addressed.

• Can distinguish between something urgent, something important, and something that can wait.

• Stay calm when a client is frustrated.

• Ask good questions and listen closely to the answers.

• Enjoy creating clarity, improving processes, and leaving things better documented than you found them.

• Can work independently while keeping the right people informed.

This role may not suit you if

• You need detailed instructions before taking action.

• You avoid difficult client conversations.

• You regularly rely on memory instead of documenting information.

• You consider sending a message to be the same as completing the follow-through.

• You wait for a client to complain before addressing a concern.

• You enjoy talking to clients but dislike the operational work required behind the scenes.

• You need frequent chasing to close loops.

Experience

• We care more about judgment, ownership, and communication than a perfect CV

• Experience in client success, WordPress development, Google Analytics and good understanding of technical SEO, account management, project coordination, or a service-based bus

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As Director, Global Field Sales Operations, you’ll partner with Sales and Revenue Operations leadership to run the operating rhythm of a global sales organization serving customers from Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMB) through Enterprise across multiple regions. You’ll lead forecasting, pipeline management, planning, and productivity initiatives while building a scalable field operations function. By helping sales teams operate with greater clarity and consistency, you’ll support 1Password’s mission to help businesses protect what matters most with simple, human-centric security. Reporting to the Vice President, Revenue Operations, this role is remote in the USA or Canada.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate - from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs - creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

• 8+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, or sales strategy and operations within Business-to-Business (B2B) software, including 3+ years leading teams.

• Deep experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, sales process, and operating rhythms across multiple segments.

• Experience leading annual planning, territory design, quota setting, and in-year adjustments.

• Experience supporting sales organizations across multiple regions, including Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA).

• Ability to build trusted relationships with senior Sales leaders, communicate clearly, and influence decisions using sound judgment and data.

• Experience hiring, developing, and coaching strong sales or revenue operations leaders.

• Experience using Salesforce and artificial intelligence (AI) to improve forecasting, pipeline management, or sales productivity.

What you can expect:

• Partner with Sales leaders to set quarterly priorities, align hiring plans and trade-offs, and create recovery plans when teams fall behind.

• Establish consistent global standards for forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and quarterly business reviews.

title: Investigator, Special Investigative Unit
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary Provides investigative support for special investigation unit (SIU) activities. Responsible for supporting for the prevention, detection, investigation, reporting, and when appropriate, recovery of money related to health care fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA). Responsible for reviewing and analyzing information to draw conclusions on allegations of FWA and/or may determine appropriateness of care, and recognizing and adhering to national and local coding and billing guidelines in order to maintain coding accuracy and excellence.
Essential Job Duties

• Responsible for developing leads presented to the special investigation unit (SIU) to assess and determine whether potential fraud, waste, or abuse (FWA) is corroborated by evidence.
• Conducts both preliminary assessments of FWA allegations, and end-to-end investigations, including but not limited to witness interviews, background checks, data analytics to identify outlier billing behavior, contract and program regulation research, provider and member education, findings identification and communications development, recommendations and preparation of overpayment identifications, and closure of investigative cases.
• Completes investigations within the mandated period of time required by either state and/or federal contracts and/or regulations.
• Conducts both on-site and desktop investigations.
• Conducts low to medium, and extensive investigations, including reviews of medical records and data analysis, and makes determinations as to whether the investigation and/or audit identified potential FWA.
• Performs accurate and reliable medical review audits that may also include coding and billing reviews.
• Produces audit reports for internal and external review.
• Coordinates with various internal customers (e.g., provider services, contracting and credentialing, healthcare services, member services, claims, etc.), to gather documentation pertinent to investigations.
• Detects potential health care FWA through the identification of aberrant coding and/or billing patterns through utilization review.
• Prepares appropriate FWA referrals to regulatory agencies and law enforcement.
• Documents appropriately all case related information in the case management system in an accurate manner, including storage of case documentation following SIU related requirements.
• Prepares detailed preliminary and extensive investigation referrals to state and/or federal regulatory and/or law enforcement agencies when FWA is identified as required by regulatory and/or contract requirements.
• Renders provider education on appropriate practices (e.g., coding) as appropriate based on national or local guidelines, contractual, and/or regulatory requirements.
• Interacts with regulatory and/or law enforcement agencies regarding case investigations.
• Prepares audit results letters to providers when overpayments are identified.
• Ensures compliance with applicable contractual requirements, and federal and state regulations.
• Complies with SIU policies as and procedures as well as goals set by SIU leadership.
• Supports SIU in arbitrations, legal procedures, and settlements.
• Actively participates in Medicaid Fraud Control Unit (MFCU) meetings and roundtables on FWA case development and referrals.
• May work with other internal departments, including compliance, corporate legal counsel, and medical affairs to achieve and maintain appropriate anti-fraud oversight.

Required Qualifications

• At least 2 years of investigative experience in the health care industry, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
• Valid and unrestricted driver’s license.
• Proven investigatory skills including ability to organize, analyze, and effectively determine risk with corresponding solutions, and remain objective and separate facts from opinions.
• Knowledge of investigative and law enforcement procedures with emphasis on fraud investigations.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) (m/w/d)
description:
Du brennst für Kommunikation und suchst nach einer Aufgabe, bei der dein Erfolg direkt sichtbar ist? Dann bist du bei uns absolut richtig!🚀
Als junge Full-Service-Marketingagentur begleiten wir Unternehmen durch digitale Herausforderungen. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Marken auf Plattformen wie LinkedIn, TikTok etc. sichtbar werden und planbar neue Kunden gewinnen.
Wenn du Bock hast, aktiv auf Unternehmen zuzugehen und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen, bieten wir dir den idealen Platz - und du entscheidest, wo dieser ist! 🔥
Aufgaben

•
Aktive Ansprache: Du kontaktierst gezielt potenzielle B2B-Kunden per Telefon und stellst ihnen unsere innovationen Marketing- und Recruiting-Lösungen vor.

•
Beziehungsaufbau: Mit deiner sympathischen Art weckst du echtes Interesse bei Geschäftsführern und Entscheidern verschiedenster Branchen.

•
Terminierung: Dein Ziel ist es, qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unsere Strategieberater zu vereinbaren um so den Grundstein für neue Partnerschaften zu legen.

•
Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du dokumentierst deine Gespräche in unserem CRM-System und behältst deine Kontakte im Blick.

•
Team-Austausch: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Sales-Team zusammen und bringst deine Ideen ein, um unsere Ansprache kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Qualifikation

•
Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst komplexe Themen einfach erklären und hast ein Gespür für dein Gegenüber.

•
Positive Ausstrahlung: Auch wenn ein Gespräch nicht zum Ziel führt, bleibst du motiviert und freundlich - für dich ist das nächste Telefonat eine neue Chance.

•
Sicheres Auftreten: Du kannst souverän mit Entscheidern auf Augenhöhe kommunizieren.

•
Engagement: Du arbeitest zielorientiert und hast den Ehrgeiz, dich stetig weiterzuentwickeln.

•
Deutschkenntnisse: Du beherrschst die deutsche Sprache sicher in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits
💸 Planbares Einkommen + Bonus: Du erhältst ein attraktives Fixgehalt sowie zusätzliche Provisionen für jeden vereinbarten Termin.
🌴 Maximale Flexibilität: Ob 100 % Remote von zu Hause oder von woanders - du entscheidest wo dein Office ist.
🕐 Voll- oder Teilzeit: Wir bieten dir verschiedene Arbeitszeitmodelle an, die zu deiner Work-Life-Balance passen.
📌 Fundierte Einarbeitung: Wir lassen dich nie allein. Durch intensives Mentoring und regelmäßige Coachings machen wir dich fit für den B2B-Vertrieb.
🤝 Junges High-Performance Team: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine moderne Unternehmenskultur warten auf dich.
Bei Digital Trendteam legen wir Wert auf Persönlichkeit und Motivation. Wir suchen Teammitglieder, die gemeinsam mit uns die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden gestalten wollen.
Ein langes Anschreiben ist bei uns nicht nötig - uns interessiert dein Werdegang und vor allem deine Motivation.
Klingt nach deinem nächsten Job? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und lass uns gemeinsam wachsen! 🤝🏻

title: NPI Build Manager
description:
Who You’ll Work With
Partner with Hardware Engineering and cross-functional teams to establish and execute CM build schedules, ensure full build readiness, remove critical roadblocks, and hold internal partners and CMs accountable for delivery against aggressive Time-to-Market targets.
What You’ll do
Own end-to-end execution and operational accountability for New Product Introduction (NPI) builds at assigned Contract Manufacturing (CM) sites, driving programs from Prototype through successful market launch, including TQ (Transfer Qualification) builds and EFT (Early Field Trial) units.
Responsibilities:

• Drive alignment with Hardware Engineering on NPI milestones, build quantities, EFT requirements, priorities, and Time-to-Market commitments.

• Own and drive CM build schedules across multiple concurrent programs, managing priorities and capacity to deliver against committed dates, quantities, and milestones.

• Drive full NPI build readiness , ensuring materials CTB, capacity, staffing, tooling, equipment, manufacturing, test, engineering, debug, and rework resources are available.

• Ensure NPI Material Managers align material availability and CTB with the NPI build schedule and Supply Commit Review (SCR) .

• Monitor upcoming Arista Build Start Requirements (ABSR) and proactively address readiness gaps before they impact the build.

• Drive CM execution of NPI and TQ builds , taking immediate corrective action on schedule variance and enforcing recovery plans for at-risk builds.

• Serve as the single point of accountability and escalation for operational issues impacting NPI execution, driving rapid cross-functional resolution of critical-path roadblocks.

• Identify opportunities to pull in build schedules , facilitate capacity and allocation decisions between NPI and production, and escalate when additional resources or leadership support are required.

• Lead cross-functional alignment across Hardware Engineering, NPI Materials, Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Planning, Quality, POMs, NPI Engineering, and CM teams to deliver build targets.

• Partner with POMs to secure product-specific manufacturing, test, quality, and operational requirements impacting build execution.

• Maintain executive visibility into build status, risks, recovery actions, and resolution paths , ensuring committed builds are completed successfully and on time.

• Enforce CM accountability for NPI execution, own NPI-related inputs and scoring metrics for the CM QBR , and drive corrective actions for recurring execution issues.

• Drive lessons learned, standard best practices, and process improvements to improve build readiness, schedule predictability, and CM execution across assigned sites.

• Ensure mass production PO readiness at Pre-Pilot (PPLT) .

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Manufacturing, or related relevant field.

• 5-8 years of experience in NPI, manufacturing, operations, program management, or contract manufacturing.

• Experience managing NPI builds and working directly with Contract Manufacturers .

• Strong understanding of NPI processes, build readiness, manufacturing operations, and schedule management .

• Proven ability to drive execution, manage competing priorities, and deliver against a ggressive Time-to-Market targets .

• Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to hold internal and external teams accountable .

title: Senior HR Business Consultant
description:
Jij maakt het mogelijk
Een CEO die met 80 mensen een reorganisatie in moet en jou belt voordat hij het zijn MT vertelt. Een leiderschapsteam dat jouw hulp inroept omdat het na twee jaar hard groeien merkt dat de oude manier van werken vastloopt. Een collega-VIE'er die bij een eerste groot veranderproject even met je wil sparren over hoe ze de weerstand in het team aanpakt. En dat is slechts een deel van je werkweek.
Als Senior HR Business Consultant ben je de sparringpartner van founders, CEO's en MT's van ambitieuze groeibedrijven en werk je voor meerdere bedrijven tegelijkertijd. Je weet wat er speelt als een organisatie van 40 naar 150 mensen gaat en je helpt ze daar doorheen: organisatie-inrichting, leiderschap, cultuur, performance. Vooral verandering is jouw ding. Je weet dat een nieuwe structuur bedenken makkelijk is en dat het echte werk begint zodra mensen er iets van gaan vinden.
Je kijkt ook verder dan je eigen opdrachten: waar kunnen we een klant nog beter helpen, welke nieuwe klant past bij ons, wat hebben we nodig om te groeien? VIE staat voor een volgende stap en we willen dat jij een van de mensen bent die mee gaat bouwen aan onze organisatie.
Requirements
Jij hebt het
Je hebt ruime ervaring in HR, als HR-lead , HR-manager, coach, veranderkundige of consultant, en je hebt aan tafel gezeten bij een MT. Je hebt organisaties zien groeien, krimpen of veranderen en kan goed tegen verandering. Verder herken je jezelf hierin:

• Je hebt mensen aangestuurd en je vindt het oprecht leuk om anderen beter te maken. Je geeft feedback die ergens over gaat en je trekt je team mee zonder alles zelf te willen doen.

• Je denkt commercieel. Je ziet kansen bij klanten, je durft het gesprek over een vervolgopdracht aan te gaan en je vindt het niet vies om over omzet te praten.

• Je hebt verandertrajecten geleid en weet hoe je een organisatie meekrijgt.

• Je bent ondernemend en wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat er moet gebeuren.

• Je gelooft meer in de waarde van een goede confrontatie dan in de status quo behouden. Daarom stel je de vraag achter de vraag, ook als dat ongemakkelijk is. En als je vastloopt, vraag je hulp.

• Je gebruikt tech en AI in je werk omdat je snapt dat het je tijd geeft voor wat er echt toe doet.

• Je begrijpt hoe organisaties werken en kan HR-overstijgend meedenken en kijken.

• Je voelt je thuis bij onze kernwaarden: samen doen, oprecht direct en beter maken.

Dit verdien jij

• Een team collega's met samen honderden jaren People & Culture-ervaring, en een plek waar je die ervaring zelf ook doorgeeft

• Werk bij uiteenlopende groeibedrijven, met ondernemers die weten wat ze willen (of juist niet, en daar help je dan bij)

• Regie over je eigen agenda en de vrijheid om nationale feestdagen op te nemen wanneer het voor jou belangrijk is en autonomie over je eigen werk

• Tijd om je in te zetten voor een goed doel of vrijwilligerswerk. We zijn niet voor niets een B Corp

• Een salaris dat past bij je ervaring en bij deze rol binnen de range van € 5.083 - € 6.877, plus de rest van onze voorwaarden die je hier vindt

Hoe verder?
Nieuwsgierig? Laten we koffie drinken, gerust eerst gewoon om kennis te maken. Neem direct contact op met Wouter, CEO van VIE People , via of +31 (0) 6 506 025 72.

title: ANALISTA DESENVOLVEDOR PL (Cobol)
Full Stack Tech Lead Engineer - Remote
description:
FormativGroup is hiring an Full Stack Tech Lead Engineer to join a Financial Services technology organization that builds and maintains digital products for tax professionals. The team develops internal tools, financial dashboards, analytics, reporting solutions, and other technology that improves how client-serving professionals work.
This is a hands-on Full Stack Tech Lead Engineer role for an experienced technical lead who wants to step into people leadership without stepping away from delivery. You will serve as both the senior technical authority and the people leader: contributing code, setting technical direction, reviewing work, strengthening engineering practices, and helping the team use AI agents effectively across the software development lifecycle. The environment includes legacy .NET/C# services and Angular front ends alongside newer Python, Node.js, and React development. You will help modernize the stack in phases while keeping business-critical components stable.
What You'll Work On

• Lead from the keyboard: contribute production code regularly, use AI agents as part of day-to-day delivery, and stay close to the technical work.

• Own the team’s technical direction, architecture decisions, long-term technical health, and roadmap across new delivery, modernization, and technical debt.

• Lead phased modernization of legacy .NET/C# and Angular components while building new capabilities with Python, Node.js, and React.

• Break work into small, well-bounded tasks and route each task to the best executor - an engineer, an agent, or yourself - while keeping coordination lean and outcome-focused.

• Own pull request review and provide fast, technically substantive feedback.

• Build and manage the technical-debt backlog, resolving priority issues directly instead of relying only on delegation.

• Hire, evaluate, coach, and grow engineers; set the technical hiring bar and help the team work effectively with AI agents.

• Create and maintain agent operating instructions, verification protocols, and human-in-the-loop controls for code, tests, documentation, and infrastructure changes.

• Run evaluation checks before merge and retain human-owned merge control for production branches.

• Maintain strong automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, and uphold consistent engineering practices across design, coding, testing, release, and operations.

• Drive CI/CD automation, containerized delivery, and Infrastructure as Code for cloud-native applications.

• Track engineering health and delivery metrics, including required reporting through Atlassian Compass.

title: Fachlicher Softwaretester (m/w/d) Bankanwendungen
description:
Deine Rolle
Du kennst den Bankalltag und weißt, worauf es bei Qualität und Genauigkeit wirklich ankommt? Dann ist das deine Chance, deine bankfachliche Erfahrung in die Welt der Softwarequalität einzubringen.
Als Softwaretester (m/w/d) im Bankenumfeld verbindest du dein Verständnis für Abläufe, Produkte und Prozesse im Bankgeschäft mit einem Blick für technische Details. Du prüfst, ob neue oder weiterentwickelte Systeme fachlich korrekt funktionieren, also so wie Bankkaufleute sie wirklich brauchen.
Wenn du also aus der Bank kommst und mehr Einblick in die IT gewinnen möchtest oder bereits als Softwaretester im Bankumfeld tätig bist und deine bankfachliche Expertise weiter ausbauen willst, bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Über uns
Die CPU Consulting & Software GmbH  ist seit über vier Jahrzehnten als IT-Partner der Finanzbranche erfolgreich. Als Teil der CPU-Gruppe verbinden wir tiefes  Banking-Know-how  mit Technologiekompetenz und begleiten Banken sowie IT-Dienstleister bei der digitalen Transformation - von der Idee bis zum Go-live.
Du stellst sicher, dass Softwarelösungen nicht nur technisch einwandfrei , sondern auch fachlich präzise und bankkonform umgesetzt werden. Damit leistest du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Qualität und Zukunftssicherheit moderner Banking-Systeme.
Aufgaben

• Du analysierst Anforderungen und entwickelst darauf basierend Testfälle und Testkonzepte.

• Du führst manuelle und automatisierte Tests durch und dokumentierst Ergebnisse präzise.

• Du unterstützt bei Abnahmetests direkt beim Kunden und begleitest Fachbereiche bei der Einführung neuer Systeme.

• Du trägst zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Teststrategie bei und bringst neue Ideen zur Qualitätssicherung ein.

• Du arbeitest eng mit Business Analysten, Entwicklern und Fachabteilungen zusammen - auf Augenhöhe und lösungsorientiert.

Qualifikation

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Bankkaufmann/-frau oder bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bankwesen mit.

• Du bist neugierig auf IT und möchtest deine bankfachliche Expertise in Softwareprojekte einbringen .

• Alternativ hast du bereits Erfahrung als Softwaretester im Bankumfeld.

• Eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung ist von Vorteil, ebenso wie Erfahrung mit Testtools wie Jira, Confluence, Aqua, Postman, Selenium, Cypress oder FitNesse.

• Du arbeitest strukturiert, qualitätsbewusst und verlierst auch in komplexen Szenarien nicht den Überblick.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

Benefits

•
Zukunftssicherheit:
Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und eine Bezuschussung der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% geben dir Stabilität und Sicherheit für deine Zukunft.

•
Innovatives und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld:
Wir bieten dir eine langfristige Perspektive in einer Branche, die sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt mit Raum für persönliches Wachstum. Durch gezielte Schulungen erhältst du die Möglichkeit, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und dich in der IT-Welt weiterzubilden.

•
Attraktive Vergütung:
Wir schätzen deine Leistungen! Im Hinblick auf deine Qualifikationen bieten wir dir eine Vergütung zwischen 55.000 und 85.000 Euro brutto im Jahr, abhängig von Berufserfahrung und Senioritäten-Level.

•
Flexibilität:
Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gleitzeitkonto und die Möglichkeit mobil zu arbeiten, um dein Berufs- und Privatleben optimal miteinander zu vereinbaren.

•
Benefits :
Nutze unser attraktives Hardware- und Bike Leasing sowie den Zugang zu einem Mitarbeiterrabattportal mit 600 namenhaften Unternehmen und spare dabei Geld.

Du findest dich in unserem Profil wieder? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! Bitte sende uns hierzu deine vollständige, deutschsprachige Bewerbung mit frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung zu.

This is a hands-on role where you will be tasked with content creation, appealing to new market sectors, digital marketing of email campaigns, webinars, events, and product communications initiatives. You will be responsible for building and scaling programs that convert ACLED 's global audience into active users, partners, and customers.
You will work cross-functionally with sales, research, and a specific market focused director to translate ACLED 's data and insights into compelling campaigns that drive measurable growth. The ideal candidate will blend creativity with analytical rigor and action, and who thrives in creating repeatable growth from the ground up.
This position is fully remote and takes part in the marketing team leadership, and reports to the Director of Revenue, with a dotted line to the Strategic Advisor.
Specific Roles and Responsibilities
Growth & Demand Generation

• Own and execute ACLED 's growth strategy across key channels, with a focus on pipeline generation and audience expansion.

• Build and optimize multi-channel campaigns that drive engagement, conversion, and revenue.

• Develop and continuously improve lead generation and nurturing funnels in partnership with sales.

• Generate ideas and campaigns around ACLED products and initiatives

Email & Automation

• Own the email program end-to-end (newsletters, nurture sequences, campaign sends).

• Segment audiences and personalize messaging to improve engagement and conversion rates.

• Build automated workflows and lead scoring within CRM and automation tools (e.g., Salesforce).

• Continuously test and optimize subject lines, content, and cadence based on performance data.

Webinars & Virtual Events

• Own the overall strategy and operational execution of industry events, webinars, and virtual roundtables as a core growth channel.

• Identify themes, speakers, and target audiences aligned with ACLED 's commercial priorities.

• Drive webinar promotion, registration, attendance, and post-event conversion.

• Repurpose webinar content into ongoing content assets.

• Manage event promotion, logistics, and follow-up to maximize pipeline impact.

• Partner with sales to ensure effective pre- and post-event engagement strategies.

Product Communications

• Translate ACLED 's data products and insights into clear, compelling value propositions and messaging.

• Own and/or support product launches, feature releases, and positioning across target segments.

• Develop sales collateral (one-pagers, decks, case studies) that enable sales and educate buyers.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align messaging across research, analysis, and revenue teams.

Analytics & Optimization

• Track, measure, and report on campaign performance across all channels (email, events, webinars, digital).

• Use data to identify trends, optimize campaigns, and improve ROI.

• Build reporting frameworks tied to growth and revenue goals.

• Develop a strategy to optimize ACLED ’s Linkedin profile and increase audience reach and target.

Skills and Competencies
ACLED is seeking applicants who have the following skills and experience:

• 5+ years of proven experience in marketing and digital roles, ideally from the impact sector (tech for good, global social enterprise, or commercial experience from an INGO), identifying target audiences and leading campaigns that engage, educate, and motivate.

• Self-starter, with experience working remotely, who has a desire to learn, grow, and excel in their role.

Zencargo is building a world of smarter trade. We combine expert global freight forwarding (ocean, air, road, rail) with Luca, our AI co-pilot, to deliver real-time visibility, proactive exception management, and supply chains that become customers' competitive advantage. Join us to shape products that automate logistics, reduce disruptions, and drive measurable efficiency for global shippers.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced Product Manager to take ownership of a meaningful area of the Zencargo platform and help transform how global freight is managed. This is an opportunity to digitise and automate complex processes in an industry that still relies heavily on manual work, emails, spreadsheets, and operational knowledge. AI is central to both what we build and how we work. You will help identify and deliver AI-powered features that improve supply chain efficiency, while also using modern AI tools throughout discovery, analysis, prototyping, specification, and delivery.

title: Creative Technologist
description:
TL;DR - We're seeking an exceptional Design Engineer to build the tooling that makes AI-native brand production actually work at scale. You might call yourself a design engineer, creative technologist or even a full-stack product engineer who cares about craft. Here you’ll be someone who builds real infrastructure specifically in service of brand and creative output, working alongside brand designers who owns taste and direction.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What you'll do

In one sentence: build the front-end surfaces and the AI-generation systems that let Lovable’s brand team produce at scale without losing its taste.

- Build pipelines connecting image/video generation APIs, internal tooling, and the systems brand and marketing already use (Lovable, Design tools, CMS, the marketing site, Slack)

- Own reliability and versioning for the AI-generation system so brand output doesn't silently drift in quality or style over time

- Work closely with a Brand Designer who owns taste and direction - you're building the system that lets their judgment scale, not just executing tickets

- Constantly evaluate new models, APIs, and generation tooling as the landscape moves, and rebuild pipelines when something better comes along

What we're looking for

- Solid engineering fundamentals - you have a track record of building, shipping, and maintaining real full-stack software

- Genuine interest in AI generation systems (image/video models, fine-tuning, prompt pipelines) as a technical problem, not just as a user; you’ve built something with these APIs, even if only for yourself

- Experience translating scrappy explorations into production-ready systems

- Some design sensibility is a strong plus - you don’t need to be a designer, but you can tell when output is off-brand without it being spelled out, and you enjoy working closely with people who have strong taste

- Comfortable building for a function with no internal precedent - you'll be making calls with no playbook to lean on

- You’ll push the boundaries of what's possible with generative pipelines the way our Design Engineers push the boundaries of the web

Nice to have

- Experience with Lovable or similar AI-native building tools

- Prior work on marketing sites, design systems or brand tooling

- Portfolio or side projects that show both craft and curiosity

Our tech stack

title: Remote Customer Support Specialist
description:
Description
We are looking for dependable, detail-oriented Remote Customer Support Specialists to support a US-based affordable housing services operation.
This opportunity involves supporting residents, prospective tenants, and authorized third-party representatives across three key functions: maintenance support, housing locator services, and open-line reporting.
Depending on the type of inquiry, you may assist residents with submitting maintenance requests, help prospective tenants identify suitable affordable housing opportunities, or document formal reports involving concerns, complaints, compliments, and other requests.
This role requires more than general customer service skills. Successful candidates must be excellent communicators, accurate recordkeepers, and confident in asking probing questions to gather complete information. You must also be able to remain professional, objective, and emotionally composed when handling sensitive or potentially distressing situations.
Candidates must be flexible and available to work any of the listed shifts, as assignments will be determined according to business needs.
Key Responsibilities
Maintenance Support

• Handle inbound calls from residents requesting maintenance work orders for their individual units, community grounds, or buildings.

• Ask relevant questions to understand reported issues and accurately document caller information and detailed descriptions of maintenance concerns in the YardiOne online portal.

• Ensure information is complete and clear to support appropriate follow-up by maintenance personnel.

Housing Locator

• Handle inbound calls from prospective tenants interested in applying for affordable housing or joining property waitlists.

• Gather and document caller information and housing preferences.

• Use YardiOne to identify matching properties and generate lists containing property contact information and waitlist status.

• Send requested property lists by email or physical mail within 48 hours.

Open-Line Support

• Handle inbound calls from residents and third-party representatives regarding concerns, compliments, and requests unrelated to maintenance.

• Ask probing questions, accurately document formal reports in the designated web portal, and route them to the appropriate property leadership based on established criteria, including whether the caller has previously contacted property staff.

• Handle sensitive topics, including abuse, security concerns, and evictions, with professionalism and strict objectivity.

• Maintain emotional composure, avoid personal opinions, and do not offer apologies when documenting formal reports, as these calls may be used in formal proceedings.

Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. Your job is to make this team scale, hiring and developing exceptional engineers, setting technical direction across engagements, and building the repeatable delivery practices that let us bring physical AI to more platforms and more customers without sacrificing quality or speed.

You'll represent Applied Intuition with authority in front of defense and government customers, own delivery outcomes across a portfolio of concurrent programs, and serve as the escalation point when projects hit ambiguity, changing requirements, or hard technical tradeoffs. You'll be expected to stay close to the technology, reviewing architectures, pressure-testing integration approaches, and diving in when a program needs it. Fielding intelligent machines is a systems problem spanning software, hardware, and operations, and your team sits at the center of it.

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

- Work directly with defense and government customers to deploy, integrate, and operationalize Applied Intuition's vehicle intelligence products in military and government environments, from defense contractors to forward operating bases

- Tackle a broad range of technical challenges, including software engineering, operating system configuration, system deployment, and hardware integration

- Bridge customer-built systems and Applied’s solutions to deliver tangible value

- Design and implement scalable, consistent approaches for customer engagement and project execution

- Develop architectural solutions that improve consistency and scalability across projects

- Collaborate with internal engineering, product, and customer teams to ensure successful outcomes

- Take ownership of technical outcomes and drive projects to completion, adapting to changing requirements and priorities

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

- 8-12 years of industry experience with at least 2 years, recent technical leadership exposure.

- Production grade SW experience. Has deployed SW or HW systems to active customers (not R&D, one-off projects)

- Exceptional customer-facing skills and focus on solving customer problems

- A proven mentor and leader of engineering talent

- Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering

title: Estimator
description:
Just Solutions Group is looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Estimator / Bid Writer to join the team. The Estimator will be responsible for preparing accurate and competitive cost estimates and writing detailed bids for residential and commercial projects. This includes analysing drawings, specifications, and other documents to assess material, labour, and time requirements. You will work closely with the commercial, design, production, and procurement teams to ensure projects are accurately scoped and priced from concept through completion.

• Review tender portals for new opportunities.

• Liaise and negotiate with Supply Chain.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

• Strong understanding of construction methods, materials, and cost drivers.

• Proficiency in estimating software (e.g., CostX, Bluebeam, Buildertrend, Excel).

• Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications.

• Excellent communication skills and time management skills.

• High attention to detail and accuracy.

• External stakeholder engagement.

• Team collaboration.

Opportunity:
CACI is seeking a HCM Cloud SAFe Agile Coach & Scrum Master to drive Agile execution excellence across a large-scale federal HCM modernization program deploying Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM for federal civilian employees across multiple agencies. The SAFe Agile framework serves as the delivery engine that makes this complexity manageable. As an Agile Coach and Scrum Master, you will facilitate Agile Release Train (ART) ceremonies, serve as Scrum Master for cross-functional teams across Core HR, Talent and Learning, Benefits, Compensation, HCM Application Security, and Technical/Functional Support, and coach teams on SAFe principles and practices. You may also serve as a Release Train Engineer (RTE), orchestrating Program Increment (PI) Planning, managing cross-team dependencies, tracking velocity and throughput metrics, and driving inspect-and-adapt cycles. With Oracle quarterly updates, parallel agency transitions, and comprehensive functional requirements, the program requires disciplined Agile execution at every level. This role is ideal for Agile professionals seeking to coach and lead at enterprise scale within a program shaping federal IT delivery for years to come.

The role is remote with preference for candidates in the DMV area.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as Scrum Master for one or more cross-functional Agile teams aligned to Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM modules such as Core HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning, Benefits, Compensation, HCM Application Security, or Technical/Functional Support.

• Facilitate all SAFe Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement, and inspect‑and‑adapt sessions focused on continuous improvement.

• Serve as or support the Release Train Engineer (RTE) in planning and executing PI Planning events, coordinating PI objectives, identifying cross-team dependencies, and establishing realistic commitments.

• Track and report Agile metrics including velocity, throughput, cycle time, cumulative flow, defect rates, and PI predictability to provide visibility into team health and delivery performance.

• Identify, track, and remove impediments that hinder team progress, escalating systemic issues and facilitating cross-team dependency resolution.

• Coach team members, product owners, and stakeholders on SAFe Lean‑Agile principles, Scrum practices, and a continuous delivery mindset.

• Coordinate cross-team planning for Oracle quarterly update sprints, ensuring update assessment, regression testing, and deployment activities align with PI cadence.

• Facilitate ART sync meetings, Scrum of Scrums, and system demos to maintain alignment across functional, technical, integration, and testing teams.

• Support agency transition task orders by tailoring Agile practices to each agency migration wave, scaling ceremonies appropriately for varying complexity tiers.

• Maintain and optimize Agile tooling such as JIRA and Confluence to ensure accurate backlog management, sprint tracking, and program-level reporting.

• Facilitate inspect‑and‑adapt workshops at the end of each PI and drive problem‑solving activities that result in actionable improvements.

• Operate independently to analyze and resolve complex functional and technical issues, mentor junior team members, and serve as a program-wide Agile resource.

• Lead small work efforts and technical initiatives, conduct deliverable reviews, and guide junior consultants on Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM best practices.

Qualifications:
Required:

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (US Citizenship required).

• Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of relevant experience; additional experience may substitute for the degree.

title: Logistics Analyst (Cuiabá, Brazil only)
description:
About Pyka
Pyka’s goal is to provide society with a new form of safe, clean, and cost-effective transportation enabled by autonomous electric aviation.
To get there, we’re taking a different approach than most. We're applying our technologies to every industry where autonomous electric aircraft can be useful, starting with the highest value and most dangerous jobs. In doing so, we're building game-changing products manufactured at scale, while perfecting the safety, reliability, and capabilities of our autonomy engine and electric propulsion systems. 
We design, develop and manufacture an ecosystem of technologies including proprietary flight control software, avionics, high power density motors, motor controllers, batteries, and custom carbon-fiber composite airframes.
Today, we supply autonomous electric aircraft for cargo transport and crop protection to real-world customers across four separate continents and have secured industry-first regulatory approvals from the FAA. Our cargo aircraft enables remote connectivity, enhances express delivery networks, and ensures fast and reliable shipping of critical supplies to areas in need. Our crop protection aircraft offers agricultural services providers and farmers an autonomous tool to make aerial application safer, more precise, and less harmful to surrounding environments. Both vehicles are highly economical to operate, easy to deploy, and significantly reduce C02 emissions in their respective industries. 
What you work on at Pyka makes people’s lives better now and brings the future of electric aviation one step closer each day. 

Role Overview
Pyka is seeking a Logistics Analyst to coordinate the movement of aircraft parts, tools, and equipment across our Brazil operations. Based in Cuiabá, Mato Grosso, you will be the central point of coordination for shipments, inventory visibility, logistics partners, and documentation-helping ensure critical materials reach aircraft and operational sites when needed.
You will work closely with our Brazil Operations and Maintenance teams, US Logistics team, external partners, couriers, and customs brokers. This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining shipment tracking, analytical problem-solving, process improvement, and occasional receiving and dispatch activities. You will report to the Finance and Business Manager in Brazil, Fwith functional guidance from our US Logistics Manager.

title: Senior Data Engineer, Embedded
description:
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to 10,000 employees and generated over $496 billion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries. This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity-and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.

Before you apply, consider if you can:

• Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone

• Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth

• Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)

• Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change

• Bring critical thought and opinion

• Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward

• Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify ’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization. As a Data Engineer at Shopify , your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify ’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify ’s products. As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities. Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat. Example day to day responsibilities include:

• Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them

• Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models

• Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark

• Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing

title: System Architect
description: Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV-35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness. As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers. Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production. This role is for you if… you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down. This role isn’t for you if… you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start. description:
schön, dass du hier bist

Als wachsende D2C Brand ist die langfristige Bindung unserer Kundinnen und Kunden einer der wichtigsten Erfolgsfaktoren unseres Unternehmens.
Du verstehst CRM als Wachstumstreiber und setzt Deine Ideen selbst um. Du verbindest Daten, Kreativität und Business-Verständnis, um Kundinnen und Kunden langfristig zu begeistern. AI und Automationen gehören für Dich zum Arbeitsalltag: Du nutzt sie, um schneller zu testen, Abläufe zu verbessern und mehr zu bewegen.

das möchten wir dir bieten
